title: Consolidate the complete Track 3 optimization history

acceptance_criteria.AC-INVENTORY-1: All Campaign 2 through 4 attempt records and all curated result artifacts are inventoried without deletion, renaming, or rewritten measurements.
acceptance_criteria.AC-HISTORY-1: One canonical history distinguishes foundational pre-ledger work, accepted candidates, rejected candidates, failed gates, campaign aggregates, and the current best implementation.
acceptance_criteria.AC-METRICS-1: Attempt counts, execution outcomes, wall times, correctness totals, performance values, backend counts, fingerprints, and review decisions reconcile with machine-readable evidence.
acceptance_criteria.AC-NAV-1: README, optimization plan, technical report, requirements, campaign records, experiment records, and result index point to the canonical history and label current versus historical evidence consistently.
acceptance_criteria.AC-RELEASE-1: All changed documentation links and JSON parse correctly, scoped diffs are clean, the repository tests relevant to curated artifacts pass, the graph validates, and review finds no unsupported claim.
